ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_softplus_weighted
ir.intuition: Replaced the tanh nonlinear scaling with a softplus-based positive scaling on the advantage gap to reduce similarity to existing tanh-based losses. This softplus transform acts as a smooth, positive, monotonic function emphasizing positive advantage gaps, combined with weighting by the sigmoid of the absolute advantage gap and the base example weights. This avoids sign flips and extreme saturation while preserving sensitivity to advantage magnitude. The loss negates the product of this scaled advantage and the log probability difference to encourage correct ranking.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_pos = softplus(clamp(advantage_gap, -10, 10))
loss_raw = - adv_pos * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
weights = sigmoid(abs(advantage_gap)) * weight
loss = mean(loss_raw * weights)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    adv_clamped = ops.clamp(adv_gap, -10.0, 10.0)
    adv_pos = ops.softplus(adv_clamped)
    diff = lpw - lpl
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.mul(adv_pos, diff))
    weight_mod = ops.sigmoid(ops.abs(adv_gap))
    total_weight = ops.mul(weight, weight_mod)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, total_weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
